title: Parallel merges pushed five design-debt counts above their frozen baselines, so check:adoption failed on main

source.ref: node scripts/check-adoption.mjs on main at 8b0b1909e: literal-radius 2156 -> 2165, subtle-tiny-type 0 -> 1, raw-button-bg 403 -> 405, literal-display-type 48 -> 50, raw-input 88 -> 91

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-29. MEASURED on main at 8b0b1909e: `node scripts/check-adoption.mjs` exited 1 with five classes above baseline. Each PR had passed the ratchet alone; together they rose. ATTRIBUTED per file by counting each class with the script's own countEntry at the freeze commit (fb964072a for literal-radius, raw-input and raw-button-bg; 763a20920 for literal-display-type) and at main. literal-radius +9: practice-placement.tsx +4, loom-grid.tsx +2, curate-with-vera.tsx +2, delete-account.tsx +1. raw-button-bg +2: curate-with-vera.tsx (Fill with Vera) and remix-practice-button.tsx. raw-input +3: order-fulfilment-control.tsx +2, loom-crop-editor.tsx +1 (the Straighten slider). subtle-tiny-type +1: space-loom-studio.tsx (the unsized-images note). literal-display-type +2: space-profile/circles.tsx (#2892) and contact-form-block.tsx (#2893), both copies of the Events block header's sm:text-3xl, from 2026-09-24. WHAT CLOSED IT: those sites moved onto the kit. Literal radii became rounded-control / rounded-card; the Fill with Vera chip became Button primarySoft sm and the Remix it confirm became Button; the fulfilment inputs became Input and the Straighten slider became RangeField; the note became text-muted; the three sibling Space-profile block headers (Events, Circles, Contact) became sm:text-display-h3. After merging main, bespoke-cards read 2 against 1 because of components/push/permission-card.tsx (LIVE-701), a push permission prompt rather than a browse card. It joined the entry's exclude list with its reason, and the entry was re-frozen for the basis change at the same value of 1. No baseline was raised. check:adoption reads every class held or shrank (literal-radius 2155, literal-display-type 47). Recorded as ledger fragments (ADR-1635).

CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1653). node scripts/check-adoption.mjs exits 0 with no --allow-raise.
